authority: Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew · Plants of the World Online

facts: Pennisetum alopecuroides (L.) Spreng. is treated as a synonym of Cenchrus alopecuroides (L.) Thunb.
Existing catalog ID is retained; the higher-rank GBIF match is retained as historical evidence, not species confirmation.
Kew accepts Anacis verticillata and lists Coreopsis verticillata L. as a homotypic synonym.
Different source names refer to the same taxon under the cited taxonomic treatment.
